Name: Schizoid Man
Description: The original "Schizoid Man" is Chip Martin, a graduate student who suffers from psychological instability and has the power of building and animating solid constructs with his mind. When Spider-man began mutating into the Spider-Lizard, the primal, savage part of his mind took over during a battle with Chip, possibly setting his therapy back indefinitely. It was this action that caused Sen. Martin, Chip's father, to hate Spider-Man so deeply.
